premises.text: Personal computing interfaces should be tailored to the individual rather than a single solution for all users
premises.evidence_span: imagine a world of personal computing interfaces tailored to the individual as opposed to a single solution needing to appease two billion users

premises.text: Current operating systems create confusion and inefficiency for users
premises.evidence_span: Recall a time when you couldn't put your hand on a specific document that you knew was there, your desktop was overloaded with Windows, or your mother called you frantically because she couldn't figure out how to log off from her computer on her overpopulated start menu

premises.text: A new system can provide clean delineation of workspaces and better organization
premises.evidence_span: we have a clean delineation of these spaces so you can understand sort them yourself by pulling them around

premises.text: Lumiere will enhance existing operating systems rather than replace them
premises.evidence_span: not a replacement for any sort of operating system. Rather to embrace, extend, and enhance the system of choice of two billion people

premises.text: Innovation in the industry requires collaboration among domain experts
premises.evidence_span: Lumiere's positioned uniquely with what we're building to bring together some of the domain experts and best minds in the industry to create a pace of rapid innovation

value.text: Users will benefit from a more organized and efficient computing experience
value.evidence_span: you can understand that when you click an icon, you know where it is on your taskbar and what's going to come up
